'''Arfive''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] who belonged to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jhensara]]. Arfive was one of three droids on the ship alongside [[Artoo (Jhensara)|Artoo]] and [[Arthree (Jhensara)|Arthree]].
